count_scope: One new official WHO document is accepted once as a source; its explicit uncertainty about exposure and monitoring sufficiency is counted as one counter-evidence finding, not a second independent source.
counter_evidence_and_limits: WHO has not identified evidence of ongoing transmission; this is not proof of zero transmission.
WHO cannot independently assess whether seven days of reported contact monitoring excluded all plausible causes.
WHO states laboratory-associated exposure cannot be fully excluded; this does not establish such exposure.
Reported COVID-19, rhinovirus and other findings among contacts are not attributed to household contacts and do not establish transmission from the deceased.
The 90% release and all-contact-completion summaries remain separate by date, population and source.
